Page 15 the numbers seem to be Proportional Logarithms used some time a go in Nautical Astronomy suggesting to be a set of coordonates.
Profetul

From Poroportional Logarithm Table:
3258 - 1h 25' 01" (1h 25.1' 5107.2")
3222 - 1h 25' 43" (1h 25.7' 5143.2")
3152 - 1h 27' 07" (1h 27.1' 5225.2")

3299 - 1h 24' 13" (1h 24.2' 5051.2")
3298 - 1h 24' 14" (1h 24.2' 5050.2")
2838 - 1h 33' 38"/39" (1h 33.6' 5614.2")
3288 - 1h 24' 25" (1h 24.4' 5063.2")
3294 - 1h 24' 18"/19"(1h 24.3' 5058")
3296 - 1h 24' 16" (1h 24.2' 5056.2")
2472 - 1h 41' 52"/53" (1h 41.8" 6113.2")
4516 - 1h 03' 38" (1h 03.6" 3814.2")

0708 - 2h 32' 55"/56" (2h 32.9" 9175.2")
1802 - 1h 58' 52" (1h 58.8" 7135.2")
h = hour, ' = minute, " = second
I personaly think this is the relevance of the numbers and has something to do with location of "Sun" and "Moon" though providing sets of coordontates. I'm not very familiar with astronimical navigation and I need to get more details about it - it is a lost art ;-)
On the same numbers, note that the space between last row and the first row is about 78px. In between the first 3 rows is a spacing of about 61px. This would suggest that the last row is the results row of the calculations done on the first 3 rows!
- Profetul
